info.name: Base Service
info.description: Tests for Base Service (In Kahoots with the Undead, Team 3), run through the Gateway against the real Player, World and Resource Service of the team docker-compose.yml. Run the folders in order: Setup registers a fresh player and grants it resources through Resource Service (resourceUrl), then the base is created, upgraded and deleted. Rollback uses a player id Player Service does not know, so the reward delivery fails and the food is refunded.
